# Java Audiveris 5.11 (Temurin JDK 25.0.3+9 LTS) STEMS head-corner oracle.
#
# Each target runs real HEADS in a fresh JVM, selects the live stem-capable
# heads exactly as StemsRetriever.inspectStems, and stably sorts them only by
# bounds.x. sigOrdinal is the pre-sort live-head/SIG ordinal used for stable ties.
#
# Four corners per head follow HeadLinker constructor order: TL, BL, TR, BR.
# inspectOrdinal also records HeadCorner.values order: TR, BL, TL, BR.
# ref/out/in stop immediately before CLinker.retrieveStump; STEMS never mutates SIG,
# glyph index, attachments, inters, or relations in this probe.
#
# All identities are boundary-local ordinals. Doubles include hex text/raw bits.
# FNV-1a-64 hashes cover canonical UTF-8 semantic rows with trailing newlines.
# The runner appends a SHA-256 commitment over this header and emitted body.
